title: Steady-state predicted variance as a fixed point
caption: The predicted variance repeats P⁻ → P⁻/(P⁻ + 1) + 1. The curve meets the line y = x at P⁻ = (1 + √5)/2 ≈ 1.618, giving gain 1.618/2.618 ≈ 0.618.
alt: The curve y = P/(P + 1) + 1 and the diagonal y = x cross at 1.618, marked.
description: Update with R = 1: P = P⁻/(P⁻ + 1); predict with Q = 1: next P⁻ = P + 1.
At steady state P⁻ = P⁻/(P⁻ + 1) + 1, so P⁻² − P⁻ − 1 = 0.
